long_biography.plain_text:
Chandris (Hellas) places Michael D. Chandris within a family shipping enterprise founded by his grandfather John before the First World War. After wartime losses, his father Dimitri and uncle Anthony rebuilt the fleet across cargo, tanker and passenger markets. That inherited platform preceded Michael's later management responsibilities.

Now an adviser to Chandris (Hellas), he contributes at board level to a business specialising in tanker management. Its operating model centres on experienced crews, preventive maintenance and onshore technical oversight. Chandris also serves as one of two vice presidents of the Union of Greek Shipowners.
